witness_semantics: witness/<aid>.py runs the artifact's solve.py, then independently checks: W1 store inventory balance with LAGGED arrivals (ship at t-1 arrives at t); W2 AGGREGATE warehouse outbound capacity (sum over stores); W3 non-negative inventory (demand met); W4 non-negative shipments; W5 reported objective equals recomputed cost with TRUE route costs (tol 1e-6).

c7_lag.description: C7 time-alignment error: arrivals credited same-period instead of next-period (transit lag dropped). Type-legal, feasible, cheaper (JIT with zero lead time); true lagged balance violated.

c5_scope.description: C5 quantifier-scope error: aggregate warehouse cap written per-route. Type-legal, looser, cheaper (all flow via cheap W1); true aggregate capacity violated.

c6_map.description: C6 entity-mapping error: W1's routes charged at W2's unit costs. Constraints untouched; reported objective mismatches recomputed true cost -> W5.
